paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption: Distribution of FOCUS values across political leanings
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of FOCUS values across different political leanings. The horizontal axis displays four categories: "Left bias," "Left center bias," "Quest. source," and "Right bias," presented in that order, each labeled with a curved tick. The vertical axis is labeled "FOCUS," with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and tick labels presented at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. Each category has a stacked bar composed of two colored segments, representing "HERO" (blue) and "VICTIM" (red), with the height of each segment indicating the corresponding FOCUS value. The bar associated with "Left bias" shows a blue segment with an approximate height of 0.45 and a red segment with an approximate height of 0.35. The "Left center bias" bar presents a blue segment with an approximate height of 0.4 and a red segment with an approximate height of 0.3. The "Quest. source" bar features a blue segment with an approximate height of 0.35 and a red segment with an approximate height of 0.3. Finally, the “Right bias” has a blue segment approximately 0.4 and a red segment approximately 0.3. The bars are not sorted and no bars are visually emphasized.
